verdict.rationale: Bulk operations clearly apply to a cloud platform, but the pack shows no bulk capability of Google Cloud's own: no batch APIs, no bulk or multi-resource commands, and no mass-edit features. The gcloud CLI and REST/client-library APIs are only developer building blocks for scripting such operations. Terraform-based Infrastructure Manager and API hub metadata sync are adjacent features (infrastructure as code and automated catalog reconciliation), not user-driven bulk operations across many items.
